title: Terry Lovelace's 'Dr Bug' abduction told at 2018 conference
place_text: Whiteman Air Force Base area; conference venue

tellings.quote: when he told the story about being on a table and Dr bug comes over and start and he's screaming as loud as he can and Dr bug looks over at him and says stop screaming

plain: Terry Lovelace, a man who says he was abducted near Whiteman Air Force Base in Missouri, told a 2018 conference that he lay on a table screaming as loud as he could while a being he calls 'Dr Bug' came over, looked at him and said, 'Stop screaming.' John Blitch, a former DARPA scientist (DARPA is the Pentagon's research agency) who says he too was abducted, tells Michels he heard Lovelace tell it there.
